title: For flat finitely presented maps, lci, syntomic, and the NL tor-amplitude [-1,0] conditions are all equivalent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a flat morphism of finite presentation f : X -> Y the lemma gives the four-way equivalence: f is local complete intersection; f is syntomic; NL_{X/Y} has tor-amplitude in [-1, 0]; NL_{X/Y} is perfect with tor-amplitude in [-1, 0] — the standard syntomic-lci identity packaged through the cotangent complex. The retained proof is written as the same affines-to-schemes protocol as its Noetherian sibling (collected in this same wave as L16149): the affine lci dictionary (chapter lemma affine-lci), NL identification (chapter lemma NL-affine), the Derived Categories of Schemes comparison trio (affine-compare-bounded, tor-dimension-affine, perfect-affine), landing on Divided Power Algebra, lemma flat-fp-NL-lci for the ring statement (a flat finitely presented algebra is a complete intersection iff syntomic iff its naive cotangent complex has tor-amplitude [-1,0]). Retained author proof at lines 18512-18522.
